post.text:
BREAKING: Claude now has live access to real-time stock quotes and options chain data

You can pull prices, scan option chains, check Greeks, and view your portfolio without leaving the chat

Here's how to connect the (free) API step by step: https://t.co/smqDx5uf2u

Step 1: Open a free Public account

If you don't already have one, sign up here: https://t.co/FHQsKKR1si

No commissions. No payment for order flow. Stocks, options, and crypto.

You need the account because it gives you free API access to live market data - that's what we're connecting to Claude.

Step 2: Download Claude Desktop

Go to https://t.co/jO7CfVi71H and install the desktop app (Mac or Windows).

This is different from Claude in your browser. The desktop app supports MCP servers, which is what gives Claude the ability to connect to external tools and live data.

You need a paid Claude plan ($20/month Pro works).

Step 3: Open your terminal and run one command

On Mac, open the Terminal app. On Windows, open Command Prompt.

Copy and paste this:

pip install publicdotcom-py

That's it. This installs the package that lets Claude talk to Public's data. If you've never used terminal before, this is literally just paste and hit enter.

Step 4: Let Claude Cowork edit your config file

This is the part that would normally require you to manually find and edit a settings file. I skipped all of that.

Open Claude Desktop, switch to the Cowork tab, and tell it:

"I just installed the publicdotcom-py package. I need you to edit my claude_desktop_config.json file to add the Public MCP server with my API key [KEY] and account ID [ID]."

Cowork edits the file for you. No coding required.

Step 5: Restart Claude Desktop and verify

Quit Claude Desktop completely (don't just close the window - actually quit the app).

Reopen it. Start a new chat. Click the "+" button at the bottom - you should now see Public listed as a connected tool.

Type: "What's $NVDA trading at right now?"

If Claude pulls back a live price with bid/ask and volume, you're connected. Done.

What you can do now:

"Show me the option chain for $IREN expiring next month"
Full chain with every strike, bid/ask, volume, and open interest.

"What's the delta and IV on this specific $RKLB call contract?"

Live Greeks for any option.

"Pull my portfolio and show me my positions with P&L"
Reads your actual Public account with real numbers.

All inside the same chat where you're doing your research.

Where this gets really powerful:

Claude has web search AND live brokerage data in the same conversation.

"Pull the current price of $ZETA, check IV rank on Barchart, and tell me whether I should be selling puts or buying LEAPs right now."

Claude pulls live price from Public, searches Barchart for IV data, and gives you a strategy recommendation using both sources.

No other AI can do this.

TLDR:

1. Open a free Public account https://t.co/FHQsKKRzhQ
2. Download Claude Desktop app
3. Run "pip install publicdotcom-py" in your terminal
4. Use Cowork to edit your config file (no coding needed)
5. Restart Claude Desktop
6. Start pulling live quotes, option chains, and portfolio data

Total data cost: $0
Claude Pro: $20/month

Set this up once and every conversation about stocks has real numbers behind it.

If you found this useful, consider giving me a follow @JasonL_Capital

I post daily on options, stock research, and how I actually use AI to invest.
